messages:
sarah.dev: PR #21497 ready to merge — tests failing intermittently on integration-ec2. Hoping to land before deploy blackout (2024-02-19 22:00 UTC). Can someone help rerun or advise rebase window? @release-coordinator

ci-bot: CI run 98432 — integration-ec2 failed
```
Error: terraform apply timed out (exit 137)
Last lines:
  applying...
  Error: could not allocate memory
```

omar.eng: I'll kick a targeted rerun for the ec2 group and watch. pinging infra if it's memory pressure.

liz_r: I'll do an approvals pass in ~10m. If CI stays flaky, can we opt for manual canary later or move to hotfix lane?

release-coordinator: Deploy blackout 22:00-02:00 UTC. To make canary we need merges by 21:00 UTC. If we can't get a green by then we'll defer to hotfix post-window with rollback plan.

kevin: If it's memory pressure, try rerunning with smaller concurrency: `CI_EC2_CONCURRENCY=2 ./ci/rerun-target.sh 98432` — reduces OOM flake.

sarah.dev: thanks — @ci-bot please rerun integration-ec2 with CI_EC2_CONCURRENCY=2

ci-bot: queued rerun 98432-targeted (integration-ec2, ENV=CI_EC2_CONCURRENCY=2). Estimated finish ~15m.

alex_t: quick ask — if this blocks, we'll need 2 approvals for hotfix lane. Liz, can you prioritize review? Omar, if rerun fails, can you collect a small repro log?

omar.eng: yes, will attach repro logs if it fails. I'll also check instance memory metrics.

liz_r: on it. aiming to finish review within 20m.

sarah.dev: plan: Omar runs/collects logs, Liz approves, Kevin prepares quick rollback branch (if needed). If green we aim to merge by 20:50 UTC and kick canary; if not, move to hotfix lane post-blackout. I'll update PR and flag release-coordinator. :thumbsup:

release-coordinator: noted. ping here when merge changed to green so I can adjust canary targets.
